0022600192.text: The Washington Wizards (4-5, on a two-game losing streak, and 2-3 on the road) visit the Oklahoma City Thunder (7-2, on a three-game winning streak, and 4-0 at home) with Washington 8th in the East and 1.5 games behind the Southeast leader, while Oklahoma City is first in the Northwest and third in the West. Washington is without Anthony Davis (ankle sprain), Jamir Watkins (knee surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), and Oklahoma City is without Cason Wallace (shoulder surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), Jaylin Williams (back spasms), Nikola Topic (back), and Thomas Sorber (knee). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Wizards lost both games of the 2025-26 season series, most recently a 132-111 loss in Washington on March 21, 2026.
